findings.evidence: Sobolev/LipschitzDomain/Basic.lean defines IsLipschitzChartWith, IsLipschitzDomainAtWith, and IsLipschitzDomainWith at lines 122, 137, and 152; matching operations occur at 185, 191, 197, 211, 258, 285, 312, 330, and 345. Epigraph.lean:43 supplies LipschitzWith.isLipschitzDomainWith_normalEpigraph; Extension.lean:146 and subsequent declarations consume the existing charts. The new counterparts are mem_iff, mono, weaken, both image and smul operations, both finite-cover results, both invariance iff lemmas, and isLipschitzDomain_setOf_lt_fst.
findings.fix: Generalize the existing Set.IsLipschitzChartWith and IsLipschitzDomainAtWith infrastructure for arbitrary ambient spaces and uncentred charts; express the variable-bound domain condition through that shared infrastructure and migrate consumers to any canonical replacement.
findings.issue: The new chart/domain predicates create a parallel API, duplicating membership, restriction, weakening, isometry transport, dilation, finite covers, and the epigraph example without integrating existing Sobolev consumers.

summary: The PR introduces a parallel Lipschitz-domain API alongside an existing, actively consumed development and reconstructs existing dilation machinery.
